frozen_semantics.identity: opaque registry identity plus evidence/provenance; representation identity validity is runtime/lifecycle state where applicable
frozen_semantics.execution_available: executor/path exists and is available in principle
frozen_semantics.execution_ready: primitive can execute current request now; independent of residency and applied to preferred and fallback routes
frozen_semantics.residency: presence of separately acquired primitive representation only
frozen_semantics.acquisition: descriptor-driven REUSE_AMORTIZED or MANDATORY_FOR_FEASIBILITY; absent when not evidenced
frozen_semantics.lifecycle: evidence-backed preserve/evict semantics; temporary readiness loss alone does not imply eviction

frozen_invariants: NOT_READY when no route is ready
no duplicate ACQUIRE when acquisition is not startable
ANL64 plan metadata remains control-plane state rather than primitive representation
